title: shell-tools component diagram
description: The crate and what crosses its boundary: the daemon links it and calls Engine.call for each `zazzle call` (and list::stat for `zazzle stat`), handing it a Host that lends the daemon's walk cache, find scan and outlines; the library reads files itself for read, stat and diff_since.

components.name: shell-tools
components.responsibility: The library crate: manifest, README and sources.

components.name: src
components.responsibility: Request parsing, the six operations, session memory, file loading and the Host interface.

components.name: daemon
components.responsibility: zazzle's daemon: runs the operations for `zazzle call`, `zazzle stat` and the MCP tools zazzle_call and zazzle_stat, keeps one shell-tools Engine for all sessions, and implements Host.

components.name: File system
components.responsibility: The files and directories requests name.

relationships.description: A Cargo path dependency: Engine.call per request with the caller's session and working directory, list::stat for the stat command, and a Host implementation.
Reads files whole and stats paths; never writes.
